title: Perfected Macaroni and Cheese
description: A rich and indulgent macaroni and cheese recipe featuring a blend of cheeses, spices, and a crunchy Cheez-It topping.

ingredients.item: Half and half (to reach desired sauce consistency)

steps: Melt the butter in a pan and add the crushed garlic, smoked paprika, and cayenne pepper.
Whisk in the all-purpose flour to create a roux.
Gradually add the half and half to the roux to create the sauce.
Stir in the cream cheese, American cheese, and mild cheddar until melted and smooth.
Cook the macaroni and add a splash of pasta water to the sauce.
Combine the cooked macaroni with the cheese sauce.
Layer the macaroni mixture in a tray with mozzarella cheese.
Top with sharp cheddar and crushed Cheez-Its.
Bake in an oven at 400 degrees for 20 minutes or air fry at 400 degrees for 10 minutes.
notes:
The recipe uses a combination of cheeses and a unique crunchy topping made from crushed Cheez-Its.
